skill.description: Use when the user asks to "generate subject line variants", "pre-score my subject lines", or "will this subject get truncated / trigger spam filters"; produces a labeled subject + preheader variant set and a per-variant heuristic pre-score card — spam-trigger flags, length/truncation across desktop + mobile, emoji-count, and the inbox preview render (from-name + subject + preheader) — before any test is run. content.user_title: Generate and pre-screen email subject lines
content.value_statement: Weak subject lines can waste test capacity and hide the email promise on mobile. This skill generates labeled variants and checks length, spam patterns, emoji use, and inbox previews before testing.
actual_capabilities: Generates three to eight labeled subject-line and preheader variants.
Counts subject and preheader characters for desktop and mobile truncation checks.
Flags common subject-level spam patterns as estimated heuristics.
Counts emoji and applies different guidance for promotion, newsletter, and cold outreach.
Renders a from-name, subject, and preheader inbox preview.
Ranks variants and explains which candidates advance or are cut.
limitations: It does not guarantee inbox placement or reproduce mailbox-provider filtering.
It does not write email body copy, calls to action, or A/B test plans.
It relies on user-provided offer details and past campaign exports.
It does not validate pricing, scarcity, or performance claims without supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a promotion email
use_cases.description: Generate and rank promotional subject lines before sending a campaign.

use_cases.title: Review cold outreach
use_cases.description: Check business outreach subjects for emoji use, truncation, and misleading patterns.

use_cases.title: Improve a newsletter preview
use_cases.description: Compare newsletter subjects and preheaders in desktop and mobile inbox previews.

prompt_templates.title: Score existing subjects
prompt_templates.prompt: Pre-score these subject lines for mobile truncation and spam patterns. From-name: Acme. Mode: newsletter. Subjects: [paste subjects].

prompt_templates.title: Generate promotion options
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate five subject-line and preheader pairs for [offer]. Use promo mode and rank them by the heuristic pre-score.

prompt_templates.title: Check cold outreach
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four B2B cold-outreach subject and preheader variants for [offer]. Avoid emoji and flag any risky wording.

prompt_templates.title: Compare test candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these subject and preheader pairs for [audience]. Show desktop and mobile inbox previews, score each heuristic, and recommend test-ready variants: [paste pairs].

output_examples.input: Generate subjects for a summer webinar.
output: SUBJ-A | Benefit | Build a faster summer launch
Preheader: Join the practical webinar on planning and execution.
Rank: Advance SUBJ-A because the main benefit appears early on mobile.

output_examples.input: Check: FREE!!! Your offer expires today
output: Flag: Exclamation stacking and urgency claim need review.
Mobile preview: The offer is visible, but the wording may reduce trust.
Recommendation: Replace unsupported urgency with a verified benefit.

best_practices: Provide the sender name, audience, offer, and campaign mode before generating variants.
Keep the main benefit near the beginning of each subject line for mobile readers.
Treat spam and truncation results as estimated checks, then validate finalists in a controlled test.
anti_patterns: Do not present a clean heuristic score as an inbox-placement guarantee.
Do not add unsupported prices, discounts, statistics, or scarcity claims.
Do not test variants that change several message variables at the same time.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee delivery to the inbox?
faq.answer: No. It provides estimated subject-level checks, not mailbox-provider delivery decisions.

faq.question: Can it write the email body?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on the subject line and preheader.

faq.question: How many variants can it generate?
faq.answer: It generates or reviews three to eight labeled variants.

faq.question: Can I use past campaign data?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide a manual export to inform angle and length choices.

faq.question: Does it support cold outreach?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes cold-outreach guidance, including a warning for emoji use.

faq.question: What happens when details are missing?
faq.answer: It asks for an offer or subject candidates and uses clear placeholders for an unspecified sender name.
